value.rationale: Gives the complete polar base and intrinsic Jacobian singular scheme of a classical permanent cubic in all characteristics. The positive-dimensional reduced critical locus in characteristic three is mostly outside the cubic (Euler degeneracy), while a degree-eight nonreduced ribbon lies on the cubic in characteristic two. This fully classified modular transition is a motivated structural algebraic-geometric phenomenon, not only a change of a numerical invariant.
